content.title: Ansell 461-2817 Hard Hat, Universal Size, Reusable
content.short_description: Ansell 461-2817 is a reusable hard hat in a universal size, intended for head protection in industrial and facility environments.
content.long_description:
The Ansell 461-2817 is a hard hat classified under personal protective equipment for head protection applications. It is designed as a reusable unit, allowing continued use across shifts rather than single-use disposal, and is manufactured in a universal size to fit a broad range of head sizes without requiring multiple SKU variants.

This hard hat falls under the Safety & Facility > Personal Protective Equipment > Protective Equipment category, positioning it for use in maintenance, construction, warehousing, and general industrial settings where head protection is required.

Procurement and safety personnel should confirm the universal sizing accommodates their workforce and verify any site-specific compliance requirements against internal safety programs, as no certification data is included with this listing.
